_comment: cloud-ci-dto-authz-trust gate policy (the CLASS-FIX for 'caller-supplied authorization trusted as the authz decision'; sibling of cloud-ci-authz-coverage / issue #770 / AUTH-005). R0 pack-shaped DATA — all repo-specifics live here, the Rust engine is neutral. The gate flags a function iff (a) it reads a caller-supplied authorization-decision field (a parameter whose type-name tail ends with an authorization_dto_type_suffix, OR its body reads a trigger_decision_field_ident off a binding, OR it reads an authorization_header_ident in a comment-stripped string-preserving body view) AND (b) the body makes NO whole-token CALL to a pdp_decision_ident (.decide( / ensure_authorized / check_authz / ensure_authz). NOTE: verify_principal is deliberately ABSENT from pdp_decision_idents — it is an AUTHENTICATION step, not an authorization decision; a function that authenticates the principal but self-compares the authz DTO is still flagged. FN-06 inversion: self-compare operators are description-only (Vec::contains / binary_search / is_superset all evade an operator gate; the two-signal heuristic closes that class). Baseline keys include a FNV-1a body-content hash (<file>#<fn>:<hash>) to prevent same-fn-name laundering across mods. FIXED/GREEN pattern: iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/authz.rs (PrincipalVerifier::verify_principal AUTHN step + PublishAuthorizer::ensure_authorized / PDP decide() AUTHZ port, fail-closed). Ratchets vs frozen_dto_authz_trust_instances (today's known instances) so the gate lands GREEN and only NEW instances block. SHRINK-ONLY + AUTOMATED: regenerate via the gate binary --write; growing requires --allow-new; a stale key self-cleans via DAT-STALE-BASELINE. GENUINE false positives (a residual NON-AUTHORITATIVE correlation check whose authoritative PDP decision dominates the operation elsewhere, or a no-verdict fingerprint serializer) are cleared by the EXPLICIT, CURATED split_decision_allowlist (exact-key file#fn:body_hash, non-launderable, self-cleans via DAT-STALE-SPLIT-DECISION-ALLOWLIST) — NOT by any name-reachability heuristic (the unsound recognize_sibling_pdp_delegation heuristic was removed). Detection LIMITS (honest): (1) dead-code evasion: if false { .decide() } suppresses signal (b) — no reachability analysis; (2) wrong-receiver evasion: other_svc.ensure_authorized() suppresses signal (b); (3) opaque-helper evasion: a handler that hides the same authz-decision behind a helper with no authz-DTO signal is outside the envelope (human review + authz-coverage gate own that). These residuals are documented, not hidden.
_pdp_decision_idents_note: verify_principal is intentionally ABSENT: it is an AUTHENTICATION step (verifies identity from an unforgeable credential), NOT an authorization decision. A function that calls verify_principal but then self-compares the authz DTO is still flagged.
_self_compare_tokens_note: Description-enrichment only since v2 (FN-06 inversion). Not a gate precondition. Vec::contains / binary_search / is_superset all evade an operator-based gate; the two-signal heuristic (reads authz field + no PDP call) closes that class.
_split_decision_allowlist_note: EXPLICIT, CURATED allowlist of genuine FALSE POSITIVES — NOT a heuristic. The earlier recognize_sibling_pdp_delegation name-reachability heuristic was REMOVED as UNSOUND (it suppressed by function-NAME call-graph reachability, not by proving a PDP decision dominates the guarded operation, so a dead-code `if false { decide() }` PDP root + call edge, a same-named overload in a DIFFERENT impl block reached from a PDP root, and a single-file decide_access bypass all laundered a genuinely-forgeable check to GREEN). Each entry below is the SAME exact-key shape as the baseline (<file>#<fn>:<body_hash>); any body change re-keys it and re-flags it (DAT-STALE-SPLIT-DECISION-ALLOWLIST self-clean). It suppresses ONLY the exact audited body — it cannot suppress a different function that merely shares a name, nor a body edited after the audit. Every entry was hand-verified by tracing the call graph: an authoritative server-side PDP `ensure_authorized`/`decide` dominates every path to the function and the function itself NEVER grants (it returns Ok/Err on internal consistency, or serializes fields with no verdict at all).

split_decision_allowlist.justification: ADR-0591 split-decision FP. Only caller is validate_audit_event_emit_request, reached ONLY from emit_audit_event_authorized which runs the authoritative authz.ensure_authorized(verified,&resource) PDP (fail-closed/default-deny) at audit/core/usecase/src/lib.rs:433, and from the pub(crate) emit_audit_event_unauthorized_inner whose sole caller is that same post-PDP path. No external bypass caller exists. This fn only DENIES-or-passes on internal consistency (decision_id non-empty, tenant/producer match the verified envelope, surface membership); it NEVER affirmatively grants. Defense-in-depth, not the authz verdict.

ADR-0591 split-decision FP. Only caller is validate_cloud_finops_report_request, reached ONLY from generate_cloud_finops_report_from_api which runs the authoritative FinopsReportAuthorizer .ensure_authorized PDP at billing/ports/finops-api/src/lib.rs:705 (fail-closed). No external bypass. This fn only returns Ok/Err on correlation-tuple consistency (decision_id non-empty, tenant/principal match); it NEVER grants. Non-authoritative cross-check, not the verdict.

ADR-0591 split-decision FP. Called directly inside read_cloud_observability_audit_from_api which runs the authoritative AuditReadAuthorizer .ensure_authorized PDP at observability/core/api/src/lib.rs:498 (fail-closed). No external callers. This fn only returns Ok/Err on optional-DTO consistency vs the verified identity (NEVER grants — empty fields are tolerated). Non-authoritative cross-check, not the verdict.

NO-VERDICT-SERIALIZER FP. Returns an AuditEventEmitRequestFingerprint STRUCT (not a Result) — it makes NO authorization decision at all. It reads request.authorization.allowed_surfaces.join(",")/decision_id ONLY to fold them into the canonical idempotency-dedup fingerprint string. The authz verdict is the PDP in emit_audit_event_authorized (audit/core/usecase/src/lib.rs:433); a perturbed fingerprint only changes idempotency dedup, never an authorization outcome. The trigger-field read is the gate's known return-type-blind limit; this is a genuine FP.

NO-VERDICT-SERIALIZER FP. Returns a CloudFinopsReportRequestFingerprint STRUCT (not a Result) — makes NO authorization decision. Reads request.authorization.allowed_surfaces.join(",")/decision_id ONLY to serialize into the idempotency-dedup fingerprint. The authz verdict is the PDP at billing/ports/finops-api/src/lib.rs:705. A perturbed fingerprint affects only dedup, never authz. Genuine FP (gate's return-type-blind limit).

_frozen_baseline_note: Baseline cleared for v2 re-keying (keys now include FNV-1a body-content hash: <file>#<fn>:<hash>). Regenerate via: cargo run --bin oya-cloud-ci-dto-authz-trust-app-bin -- --repo-root <root> --write --allow-new. Pre-existing caller-supplied-authorization-trust instances are FROZEN and keyed by stable <file>#<fn>:<body_hash> signature. Each below is pre-existing debt owned by its capability team, grandfathered so the gate lands GREEN and blocks only NEW instances. REMEDIATION per instance: derive the principal from a verified mTLS/SVID/bearer credential, call the cloud-iam Cedar PDP server-side to decide(principal, action, resource), and fail closed — do NOT trust the caller-supplied authorization DTO/header as the verdict. The GREEN reference is iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/authz.rs (PrincipalVerifier::verify_principal AUTHN + PublishAuthorizer::ensure_authorized / PDP decide() AUTHZ port).

product_contract.born_blocking: Born-blocking vs a frozen baseline of currently-known caller-supplied-authz-trust instances. The FIXED iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/authz.rs PDP-port pattern is GREEN by construction. Pre-existing instances are frozen in frozen_dto_authz_trust_instances (shrink-only). Only a NEW instance blocks.
product_contract.pack_shaped: Neutral engine; every repo-specific is DATA in this file. A different repo adopts the gate by repointing the policy.
product_contract.fail_closed: No shell/network/VCS/clock/rand. A read-only walk of the candidate tree's Rust source. Malformed policy (null or empty required lists), gate-id mismatch, and a below-floor function census all fail closed.
product_contract.remediation_doctrine: iam/ports/policy-cedar-api/src/authz.rs (PrincipalVerifier::verify_principal AUTHN step on an unforgeable credential + PublishAuthorizer::ensure_authorized / PDP decide() AUTHZ port, fail-closed).
product_contract.v2_hardening: FN-01: verify_principal removed from PDP-satisfies (AUTHN not AUTHZ). FN-02: baseline key includes FNV-1a body hash. FN-03/FN-04: expanded trigger fields + corrected header spellings. FN-05: cfg(not(test)) production code no longer excluded. FN-06: self-compare inversion — flag reads-authz-field AND no-PDP-call regardless of comparison form. CORRECTNESS-01: empty required lists fail closed. FP-01: header detection on comment-stripped string-preserving view.
